propositions: Documentation-only patchsets must route to a reduced Verify lane that skips the OS/Python build matrix and expensive jobs while retaining all documentation validation gates.

The routing classifier and complete allowlist must execute from trusted origin/main with the exact patchset changeset as external data, using HEAD^..HEAD diff detection with fail-closed semantics for any uncertainty or missing parent.

All documentation gates currently inlined across verification jobs must be extracted into a single shared composite action invoked by both full and docs-only routes, with no duplicate command lists and no additional runner job added to the full lane.
Classifier logic failure or cancellation must trigger full-route job execution via always() condition while still blocking Verified, preventing an invalid route decision from voting green.

Every structural consumer test that reads the workflow definition must migrate to follow the extracted shared gates without losing assertions, and vote aggregation must treat docs-only gate failure as a blocker equivalent to other route failures.

Paths modifying routing logic, workflow definitions, or actions, plus Python, shell, dependency, test, configuration, and unrecognized paths, must deterministically select full Verify with no exceptions.
